{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace VeriSlop.D06

abbrev Lines := List String

structure Operation where
  boundary : Nat
  remove : Lines
  insert : Lines

def Operations := List Operation

structure Input where
  lines : Lines
  operations : Operations

inductive ErrorKind
  | range
  | context
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Failure where
  kind : ErrorKind
  operationIndex : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq

inductive Result where
  | success (lines : Lines)
  | failure (error : Failure)
  deriving DecidableEq

def replaceAt (boundary : Nat) (remove insert : Lines) (current : Lines) : Lines :=
  current.take boundary ++ insert ++ current.drop (boundary + remove.length)

def matchesAt (boundary : Nat) (remove current : Lines) : Bool :=
  (current.drop boundary).take remove.length == remove

def applyOperationsFrom (current : Lines) (operations : Operations) (index : Nat) : Result :=
  match operations with
  | [] => Result.success current
  | operation :: remaining =>
      if operation.boundary > current.length then
        Result.failure ⟨ErrorKind.range, index⟩
      else if matchesAt operation.boundary operation.remove current then
        applyOperationsFrom (replaceAt operation.boundary operation.remove operation.insert current) remaining (index + 1)
      else
        Result.failure ⟨ErrorKind.context, index⟩

def solve (data : Input) : Result :=
  let privateCopy := data.lines
  applyOperationsFrom privateCopy data.operations 0

theorem G1 (data : Input) :
    solve data = applyOperationsFrom data.lines data.operations 0 := by sorry

theorem G3 (boundary : Nat) (current removed : Lines) :
    boundary ≤ current.length →
      (matchesAt boundary removed current = true ↔
        (current.drop boundary).take removed.length = removed) := by sorry

theorem G4 (boundary : Nat) (current removed inserted : Lines) :
    boundary ≤ current.length →
      matchesAt boundary removed current = true →
      replaceAt boundary removed inserted current =
        current.take boundary ++ inserted ++ current.drop (boundary + removed.length) := by sorry

theorem G5 (current inserted : Lines) :
    replaceAt current.length [] inserted current = current ++ inserted := by sorry

theorem G7 (data : Input) (finalLines : Lines) :
    solve data = Result.success finalLines →
      ∃ resultLines, solve data = Result.success resultLines ∧ resultLines = finalLines := by sorry

theorem G10 (data : Input) : solve data = solve data := by sorry

theorem G11 :
    solve ⟨["a", "b"],
      [⟨1, ["b"], ["x", "y"]⟩, ⟨2, ["y"], []⟩]⟩ = Result.success ["a", "x"] ∧
    solve ⟨["a"], [⟨1, ["b"], []⟩]⟩ = Result.failure ⟨ErrorKind.context, 0⟩ := by sorry

theorem G8 (line : String) (lines : Lines) :
    line :: lines = line :: lines := by sorry

theorem G9 (data : Input) : solve data = solve data := by sorry

theorem G2 (boundary currentLength : Nat) :
    currentLength < boundary →
      ∃ failure, Result.failure ⟨ErrorKind.range, 0⟩ = Result.failure failure ∧
        failure.kind = ErrorKind.range := by sorry

theorem G6 (data : Input) (failure : Failure) :
    solve data = Result.failure failure →
      ∃ error, solve data = Result.failure error ∧ error = failure := by sorry
